milestone.invariant: Ordinary and conditional coverage review use the same checked before-state current and historical original admissions. Coverage application preserves their owned source, target and version, including an authorised earlier-account repair that retires a current record without selecting previously archived IDs. Fresh activation must not change old saved replay contracts.

Current and archived original accounts remain separately attributable. A locally retired original account can be covered under fresh v2 with empty inherited selectors; unsupported legacy original proof stays an explicit gap while a separately checked successor is preserved. Wrong owners, selectors, stage maps and prefix versions refuse; detached model presentation cannot mutate durable proof. One memo covers the immutable loaded snapshot; prepared replay uses its own snapshot.
